name: codex-tasklist
description: Persistent per-session user-request queue for Codex CLI in WezTerm

interface.shortDescription: A persistent task queue below Codex in WezTerm.
interface.longDescription: Track user requests with stable IDs, live statuses, scrolling and adjustable panel height. Opens automatically in WezTerm. Local storage; no patched Codex binary.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show and maintain the task list for this session.
